The section authorises the Solicitor-General to direct disclosure of government-held documents or information. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision authorizes appointment of court administrative officers and assignment of their duties. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision guarantees citizens’ freedom of movement, residence, departure and return, subject to limitations established by law. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision regulates limitation periods for claims arising from tax assessments and property valuations. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

The provision limits the application of constitutional protections to the armed forces according to military laws. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes the composition of the Danish Parliament, including its maximum membership and seats elected in the Faroe Islands and Greenland. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision governs recovery of evaded taxes despite expiry of the limitation period following a criminal conviction or acceptance of a sanction. It neither creates punishable conduct nor establishes a penalty; its references to offences, fines and sanctions concern conditions for tax recovery.

This provision gives members of the Government the right to propose amendments and excludes them from voting. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision abolishes privileges associated with nobility, titles, and rank. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

L’article garantit la liberté d’expression, sous réserve du respect de la loi, de l’ordre public et des bonnes mœurs. Il ne crée ni ne liste une infraction ou une sanction.
This provision sets admissibility rules for legislative proposals and amendments affecting public finances. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision governs the convening and organization of Parliament’s extraordinary session, including bureau installation and adoption of internal rules. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
Cet article fixe les conditions d’éligibilité à la présidence de la République. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune peine.

Cet article régit la composition, la nomination, les qualifications, les mandats et le renouvellement des membres de la Cour constitutionnelle. Il ne crée ni infraction ni sanction.
La disposición establece reglas procesales para iniciar la instrucción o el juicio y presentar cargos o querella. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.

La disposición establece un sistema nacional descentralizado de gestión ambiental encargado de la defensoría del ambiente y la naturaleza; no crea ni enumera conductas sancionables ni establece penas.

Regula la elección del acreedor entre una pena contractual y la indemnización de perjuicios; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una sanción por una infracción.
La disposición regula los efectos civiles de una donación revocable y los derechos de usufructo del donatario; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.

The provision governs archiving, deletion and access to registry data, and the informational status of existing registrations. It creates no offence, infraction or penalty.

The provision governs presidential promulgation and the effective date of a constitutional amendment law. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision requires controllers and processors to implement organisational and technical security measures for personal data. It does not create or list an offence or infraction, or prescribe a penalty.

This provision governs the appointment of the Chancellor of Justice for a seven-year term and removal from office only by court judgment. It does not create or list punishable conduct or a penalty.

The provision establishes principles and safeguards for judicial independence. It does not create or list any offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision establishes principles for Swaziland’s international relations. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.

This article delegates authority and establishes procedures for transfers of gendarmerie personnel. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

The provision governs government accountability to Parliament and the circumstances requiring the Government or a minister to resign. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or punitive penalty.

Cette disposition garantit la liberté d’opinion et de la presse et interdit la censure. Elle mentionne les infractions commises dans l’exercice de ces libertés, mais ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune peine.
La disposition établit des incompatibilités entre le mandat de député et certaines fonctions ou mandats. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
This provision regulates the Conseil d’État’s advisory role and legislative procedures. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

This provision guarantees individual liberty, regulates arrest and deprivation of liberty, and establishes the presumption of innocence and rights to information and legal recourse. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

This constitutional provision establishes freedom of expression and information and its limits. It mentions criminal acts, including incitement to hatred, violence or discrimination, defamation and disinformation, but does not itself create offences or prescribe penalties.

Cette disposition fixe les règles constitutionnelles relatives à l’établissement et au vote des impôts ainsi qu’aux rétributions exigibles. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.
La disposition prévoit la réception des pétitions par la Chambre des Députés selon son règlement. Elle ne crée ni infraction ni sanction.
The provision establishes incompatibilities between membership in the Government and other offices or professional activities. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision governs how members of the Government exercise their responsibilities, collectively or individually. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
Cette disposition autorise une femme enceinte à rompre son contrat sans préavis ni indemnité de rupture. Elle ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
L’article crée une infraction de discrimination dans l’emploi et prévoit une amende de 1 à 4 millions d’Ariary. En cas de récidive, l’amende est doublée et un emprisonnement de 1 à 6 mois est prévu.
L’article 89 fixe les procédures d’adoption, de modification et de promulgation des lois organiques. Il ne crée ni ne liste aucune conduite punissable ou sanction.
Cette disposition impose à l’État de formuler et mettre en œuvre une politique de l’emploi. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

L’article 61 incrimine l’entrave à l’action de la Commission Malagasy de l’Informatique et des libertés, en énumère les formes et prévoit une peine de six mois à deux ans d’emprisonnement ainsi qu’une amende de 800 000 à 8 000 000 Ariary.

The provision directly makes specified insults and defamation punishable, prescribing fines of 2,000,000–100,000,000 Ariary for the listed public targets and discriminatory insults, and 100,000–10,000,000 Ariary for unprovoked electronic insults against private individuals.
L’article définit le champ d’application des conventions collectives et interdit de déroger aux dispositions d’ordre public, sans créer ni énumérer d’infraction ou de sanction.

L’article punit le harcèlement moral au travail d’un emprisonnement de trois mois à un an et d’une amende de un à quatre millions d’Ariary, ou de l’une de ces peines seulement. Il prévoit également le doublement de la peine en cas de récidive.

L’article prévoit la mise à disposition de modèles de contrats de travail et la possibilité d’un contrôle de conformité par l’Inspecteur du travail. Il ne crée ni ne liste aucune infraction ou sanction.
Subsection (4) makes contravention of the campaign code of conduct punishable by a K5,000,000 penalty. Subsection (5) also permits disqualification for nonpayment or continued breaches.
This provision establishes Luxembourg’s system of government and foundational principles. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

Cette disposition impose que la surveillance de la santé des travailleurs soit gratuite, sans perte de gain et, autant que possible, réalisée pendant les heures de travail. Elle ne crée ni ne liste une infraction ou une sanction.
The provision classifies existing offences as arrestable for procedural purposes; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

L’article 50 encadre les pouvoirs et la procédure des missions de contrôle, notamment l’accès aux locaux et l’autorisation judiciaire en cas d’opposition. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune peine.
Subsection (6) creates an offence for inducing or influencing a candidate to withdraw from an election.
The provision prohibits discrimination and permits future legislation to make discriminatory practices criminally punishable, but it does not itself create an offence or prescribe a penalty.

This provision sets grounds and procedures for impeachment and removal from office, including future disqualification. It does not create or list a criminal offence, administrative infraction, or corresponding penalty.
The provision authorizes temporary withdrawals from the Consolidated Fund pending appropriation and requires their inclusion in the Appropriation Bill. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision authorizes the Commission to delegate its powers and functions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

L’article incrimine le fait de causer frauduleusement un préjudice patrimonial par manipulation de données informatiques ou atteinte au fonctionnement d’un système d’information, afin d’obtenir un bénéfice économique sans droit. Il prévoit deux à dix ans d’emprisonnement et une amende de 2 000 000 à 100 000 000 Ariary, ou l’une de ces peines seulement.
The provision establishes procedures for supplementary estimates and appropriation of expenditure. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision establishes the legislature’s functions and duties. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision sets out the Ombudsman’s remedial and referral powers, including recommending prosecution. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Subsection (4) makes contravention of subsection (2) an offence punishable by a fine not exceeding 100,000 ringgit, imprisonment not exceeding one year, or both.

This provision regulates the introduction of Bills and amendments involving financial matters. Its reference to fines and pecuniary penalties merely excludes them from those procedural restrictions; it does not create punishable conduct or impose a penalty.
This provision sets the Commissioner's remuneration and allowances. It creates no offence, punishable conduct, or penalty.
The provision sets qualifications for judicial appointment. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision suspends the Yang di-Pertuan Agong’s exercise of official functions when charged with an offence under another law and addresses the calculation of his term. It does not create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty for punishable conduct.
The provision limits Parliament’s legislative powers concerning land and local government in Sabah and Sarawak. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
This section provides for the temporary appointment of an acting Chairman of the Appeal Tribunal and deems that member to be the Chairman. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

Subsection (4) creates an offence for continuing to process personal data after registration has been revoked, punishable by a fine not exceeding five hundred thousand ringgit, imprisonment not exceeding three years, or both.

This article establishes procedures for parliamentary consideration and adoption of legislation, including resolving disagreements between the two chambers. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision imposes duties to appoint data protection officers and notify the Commissioner, but does not designate noncompliance as an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes the Federation’s powers concerning property, contracts, and lawsuits. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.

Subsection (5) expressly makes contravention of this section by a civil servant subject to disciplinary measures. Subsection (6) also provides for punitive damages for contraventions of subsections (3) and (4).

L’article 66 punit d’une amende de 2 500 000 à 10 000 000 de francs le traitement automatisé de données nominatives sans précautions de sécurité et la mémorisation de certaines données sensibles sans l’accord préalable de l’intéressé.
L’article 16 impose une obligation d’information lorsque les données personnelles ne sont pas collectées auprès de la personne concernée, mais ne crée ni ne liste une infraction ou une sanction.

Cet article énonce des principes de protection des données et interdit certaines décisions fondées uniquement sur un traitement informatique, sans qualifier leur violation d’infraction ni prévoir de sanction.
L’article 122 régit la procédure législative, notamment le vote et la recevabilité des propositions et amendements. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.

L’article institue et énumère des sanctions administratives, notamment l’avertissement pour non-respect des formalités de collecte, de traitement et de gestion des données, ainsi que la mise en demeure, l’injonction de cessation et le retrait d’agrément.

Cette disposition impose à l’État de garantir aux agents de l’administration des conditions de travail, de rémunération et de sécurité adéquates. Elle ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

This provision defines the Constitutional Court’s duties in reviewing presidential elections and referendums, examining complaints, and proclaiming final results. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
L’article ne définit aucun comportement punissable ni aucune peine précise ; il renvoie aux articles 65, 66 et 67 pour les sanctions pécuniaires applicables aux contrevenants.
The provision only states the bye-laws’ title, defines terms, and sets their applicability date. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
L’article 51 fixe le montant journalier des indemnités prévues à l’article 50, selon les moyens financiers disponibles et les barèmes d’institutions similaires. Il ne crée ni infraction ni sanction.
The provision imposes a duty to respect the Constitution but does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty for breaching that duty.
This provision only defines terms used in the regulations; it creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision allocates the burden of proof in proceedings for an existing offence. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision sets conditions for transferring agricultural land used for quarrying by emphyteutical concession. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision makes breaches of the Act or its regulations punishable where no specific penalty is otherwise provided, prescribing a fine of €232.94 to €2,329.37 upon conviction.
The provision requires written authorization and permits conditions to safeguard tax, but does not itself establish an offence, list punishable conduct, or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes licensing requirements and administrative measures, including suspension or withdrawal of a licence. It does not designate any conduct as an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.

The text sets application priority, eligibility, authorisation procedures, and restrictions on transferring authorisations. It does not create or list an offence or infraction, or prescribe a penalty.
The provision requires the Board to refer non-compliance to the responsible Minister. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision establishes duties for the Registrar to publish information and transmit certificates and notifications through the system of interconnection of registers. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
La disposición regula el procedimiento de imposición de sanciones (notificación, pruebas, alegatos, resolución y plazos), sin crear ni enumerar conductas punibles ni establecer penas o multas.

The provision preserves constitutional authority and requires participants in a government arising from rebellion, and those who assisted the rebellion, to be judged under the Constitution and implementing laws. It does not itself define an offence or prescribe a penalty.
El artículo prohíbe conceder títulos de nobleza, prerrogativas y honores hereditarios y reconocer los otorgados por otros países, pero no tipifica una infracción ni establece una pena o sanción.
The provision creates the crime of perjury by specifying the prohibited conduct and prescribes a penalty of up to five years’ imprisonment.
El artículo establece causas para negar el ejercicio de los derechos ARCO y obligaciones de comunicar y justificar esa decisión. No tipifica conductas sancionables ni establece penas o multas.

La disposición establece la protesta del Presidente al asumir el cargo y las autoridades ante quienes debe rendirla. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece penas; la frase «que la Nación me lo demande» no crea una sanción.

La disposición establece el deber del responsable de informar inmediatamente a las personas titulares sobre vulneraciones de seguridad significativas. No tipifica una infracción ni establece una pena o sanción.

This provision requires restitution of restrained property when charges are not brought, no conviction results, or a conviction is overturned without a timely subsequent complaint. It creates no offence or penalty.

El último párrafo establece conductas sancionables: que los diputados o senadores electos no se presenten a desempeñar el cargo dentro del plazo señalado sin causa justificada, y que los partidos políticos acuerden que sus miembros electos no desempeñen sus funciones. Aunque remite a la ley para las sanciones, el propio texto identifica las conductas que generan responsabilidad.
The provision categorizes election observers and sets conditions for recognition and accreditation. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision defines intoxication and governs its relevance to criminal intent, recklessness, and defenses. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision sets rules for calculating the amount recoverable under an existing pecuniary penalty order. It does not create or list punishable conduct or independently establish a penalty.

Section 141(2) expressly makes contravention of the secrecy obligations in subsection (1) an offence, punishable by a fine of up to one hundred thousand ringgit, imprisonment for up to one year, or both.

Subsection (4) creates an offense for intentionally refusing or failing to comply with the reporting or information duties in subsections (2) and (3), or knowingly making a materially false or misleading statement or omission in a required document. It prescribes up to three years’ imprisonment, a fine up to $25,000, or both.
The provision directly makes contempt of the specified courts punishable by authorizing each court to punish contempt of itself.

El artículo establece libertades, prohibiciones y límites laborales, pero no tipifica delitos o infracciones ni fija penas. La referencia al trabajo impuesto como pena no crea una sanción, y la responsabilidad civil por incumplimiento contractual no constituye una infracción punible.
The provision defines terms used in the chapter. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
The provision creates the crime of murder by specifying the prohibited conduct and mental states, and prescribes imprisonment for a minimum of ten years, potentially for life.
Articolul 51 consacră protecția persoanelor cu dizabilități și interzice tratamentul medical forțat, cu excepțiile prevăzute de lege, dar nu stabilește o infracțiune, o contravenție sau o sancțiune.

Section I directly imposes a one-year suspension of citizens’ rights for unjustified failure to fulfill obligations under Article 36, in addition to any other penalties prescribed by law for the same conduct.

The provision establishes the right of interested parties and competent state bodies to appeal judicial decisions under conditions prescribed by law. It does not create or list punishable conduct or a penalty.

The provision creates substantive prohibitions on ammunition transfers, including transfers by unlicensed persons, transfers to ineligible recipients, and retransfers to anyone other than a licensed dealer.
Subsection (1) creates the crime of conspiracy by making an agreement to commit a crime, coupled with an overt act by any conspirator in furtherance of the conspiracy, punishable conduct.
The provision requires the director to revise, republish, and make schedules available annually. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes rights to recognition of a violated right, annulment of an administrative act, and compensation, as well as state liability for harm caused by errors in criminal proceedings. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Provision establishes state protection for Moldovan citizens and prohibits their extradition or expulsion. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

El artículo regula vacantes, sustituciones, renuncias y licencias de personas juzgadoras. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones; la mención de destitución es únicamente un supuesto para declarar una vacante.

L’article définit les missions et pouvoirs de l’Autorité, notamment celui d’infliger des sanctions administratives et de saisir le procureur. Il ne crée ni ne catalogue d’infractions et ne fixe aucune peine ou sanction.

The provision regulates excise-duty refunds and drawbacks, including a €15 refund-processing fee. It neither creates punishable conduct nor prescribes a penalty; the reference to a crime merely describes a circumstance in which excess duty must be refunded.
The provision grants deputies immunity from persecution or legal liability for votes and opinions expressed in exercising their mandate. It does not create or list punishable conduct or a penalty.
The provision has been deleted and contains no operative text creating or listing punishable conduct or a penalty.

The provision governs the constitutional procedure for suspending and potentially removing the President from office. It does not create or list a criminal offence, administrative infraction, fine, or other punitive penalty.
The provision governs the conditions and limits for dissolving Parliament. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision establishes Moldova’s sovereignty, republican form of government, and fundamental constitutional values. It does not create or list punishable conduct or any penalty.
Le texte impose des obligations de déclaration et de confidentialité, mais ne crée ni ne liste lui-même une infraction ou une peine. Il renvoie seulement aux sanctions prévues à l’article 73.
The provision establishes the Government’s role and requires it to follow its activity programme accepted by Parliament. It does not create or list punishable conduct or penalties.
La disposición regula el inicio del procedimiento de imposición de sanciones ante un presunto incumplimiento; no tipifica conductas sancionables ni establece una sanción.

This article establishes internal reporting procedures, confidentiality duties, and protections for whistleblowers, including an exemption from criminal liability. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
L’article 75 fixe la composition, la nomination et les incompatibilités de fonctions du Conseil de la Couronne. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction.
Cette disposition fixe le délai et les modalités de paiement de sanctions pécuniaires déjà prononcées, ainsi que les intérêts dus en cas de retard. Elle ne crée ni infraction ni peine.
Article 2(2) expressly identifies usurpation of state power as a crime against the people, thereby listing punishable conduct.

This article imposes customer identification and identity-verification obligations and provides for their implementation by sovereign ordinance. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
This article defines beneficial owners and imposes information collection, retention, communication and disclosure duties. It does not itself create or list an offence, infraction or penalty.

Cette disposition organise la prorogation d’une opposition, le séquestre et la garde des fonds, ainsi qu’une limitation des poursuites pour des infractions prévues ailleurs. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne fixe aucune peine.

L’article régit l’échange, l’utilisation et la transmission de renseignements entre cellules de renseignement financier, ainsi que la motivation des refus et le retour d’information. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune peine.
Le texte règle la publication de décisions de sanction déjà prononcées, leur anonymisation, leur conservation et l’imputation de frais. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de peine.
La disposition régit la fréquence des réunions du Conseil de la Couronne et leur convocation par le Prince. Elle ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

La disposition impose la transmission d’une déclaration à la cellule de renseignement financier d’un État membre de l’Union européenne. Elle ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

The provision governs company name changes, registration requirements, and their legal effects. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty; the prescribed fees are administrative charges, not punishments.
The provision establishes deputies’ representative mandate and declares imperative mandates void. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.

Subsection (3) creates offences for failing to provide required information that the person can give or reasonably obtain, and for knowingly or recklessly providing materially false information. It prescribes a fine of up to N$8,000, imprisonment for up to two years, or both.

Articolul consacră devotamentul față de țară și obligația de îndeplinire fidelă a funcțiilor publice sau militare, inclusiv depunerea jurământului în cazurile prevăzute de lege. Nu stabilește infracțiuni, contravenții sau sancțiuni.

El artículo regula el procedimiento de protección de datos ante la falta de respuesta a una solicitud ARCO y el cumplimiento de la resolución. No crea ni enumera infracciones ni establece penas o multas; cubrir los costos de reproducción y envío es una obligación de cumplimiento, no una sanción.
The provision prohibits and invalidates constitutional amendments that diminish fundamental rights and freedoms. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision establishes eligibility and disqualification rules for National Assembly membership. It refers to existing convictions and sentences but does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Subsection (1) creates an offense for knowingly, intentionally, or recklessly aiming a laser pointer at an aircraft or its flight path. Subsection (2) sets the penalty at up to 5 years’ imprisonment, a fine of up to $10,000, or both.

This provision defines the financial intelligence service’s functions, independence and organisation. Its restriction on agents’ use or disclosure of information merely refers to sanctions provided elsewhere (Article 308 of the Penal Code); it does not itself create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty.

This provision establishes transitional rules for unlimited companies and partly paid-up shares, continuing the application of the Companies Act, 1926. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision allocates and provides for repayment of investigation expenses. It does not create or list an offence or impose a penalty for conduct; its reference to convicted persons concerns recovery of costs following offences established elsewhere.

Subsection (2) authorizes the Registrar to impose a prescribed monetary penalty on a company or officer who fails within 30 days to remedy the default or show good cause why a penalty should not be imposed. It therefore creates punishable conduct and provides its penalty.
Subsection (6) creates an offense of intentionally obstructing verification measures and prescribes imprisonment of up to three years, a fine of up to $25,000, or both.
The provision imposes employee safety and cooperation duties but does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty for breaching them.
The provision establishes a presumption that meetings, proceedings, and appointments are valid when minutes comply with section 250. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision governs auditor remuneration and requires disclosure of payments in the income statement. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision establishes equality and prohibits discrimination, but does not create or list an offence, punishable infraction, or penalty.
The provision specifies matters the Commission must consider in an investigation. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.

Article 138c criminalizes intentionally and unlawfully copying or transmitting non-public data stored in an automated system, prescribing imprisonment or a fourth-category fine. It also specifies increased penalties for particular circumstances.
The provision makes causing noise or neighbour disturbance that may disrupt nighttime rest punishable by a first-category fine.
This provision governs the addition of subsequent entries to birth, marriage, and registered partnership records. It creates no punishable conduct and prescribes no penalty.

This provision creates an offence for a person working at a public transport institution who intentionally and unlawfully opens, inspects, or discloses the contents of entrusted correspondence or packages. It prescribes up to one year and six months’ imprisonment or a fourth-category fine.
This provision requires a renewed notice of intention to marry if the marriage has not taken place within one year. It does not create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty.
This provision governs the duration, extension, and expiry of authorization for a minor’s out-of-home placement. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision creates offences of assault with intent to rob and specifies maximum imprisonment terms of 14 years for the aggravated forms in subsection (1) and 7 years for the offence in subsection (2).

This provision authorises the Commissioner to prohibit certain overseas transfers of personal information and sets out the criteria and exceptions. It does not itself create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision sets procedural rules for appealing judicial permission to marry and notifying the civil registrar. Failure to notify results in loss of the right to seek annulment on a specified ground, not an offence, infraction, fine, or other punitive penalty.
The provision authorises amendments, replacement, or repeal of Schedule 6 by Order in Council. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Deze bepaling regelt wanneer de rechter verpleging van overheidswege bij terbeschikkingstelling kan bevelen en advies kan geven over de aanvang daarvan. Het betreft regels over de oplegging en uitvoering van een maatregel, niet het strafbaar stellen van gedrag of het vaststellen van een straf daarvoor.

The provision makes possessing or controlling anything capable of forging a document, without lawful authority or excuse and with intent to use it for forgery, punishable by up to 10 years’ imprisonment.

Article 161ter criminalizes culpably causing damage, disruption, or disabling of an electricity installation, or defeating its safety measures, where specified harmful consequences result. It expressly sets prison terms or fourth-category fines according to those consequences.
The provision creates an offence of intentionally or recklessly impeding another person's breathing or blood circulation through specified acts and sets a maximum penalty of 7 years' imprisonment.

The provision creates the offence of corruptly accepting, obtaining, agreeing or offering to accept, or attempting to obtain a bribe with intent to influence an official, and prescribes imprisonment for up to 7 years.
This provision sets a consent rule for persons under 16 for the purposes of sections 208 and 209. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Article 151b criminalizes intentionally arranging or facilitating surrogacy negotiations or agreements in the course of a profession or business, publicly offering such services, and publishing offers or requests for surrogate mothers. It prescribes imprisonment of up to one year or a fourth-category fine.
This provision is a sentencing rule authorising forfeiture of interception devices following conviction under sections 216B or 216D; it does not itself create or list punishable conduct.
This section establishes a procedure for consulting another authority and referring a complaint to it. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes Parliament’s three-year term and applies another statutory provision. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision imposes duties to provide necessaries and protect a vulnerable adult from injury, but does not itself create an offence or prescribe a penalty for breaching those duties.
The provision establishes the Commission’s independence and does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision authorises administrative penalties for violations of the Act or subsidiary legislation and establishes their maximum amounts: the greater of N10,000,000 or 2% of annual gross revenue for entities of major importance, and the greater of N2,000,000 or 2% for other entities.
The provision allocates joint and vicarious liability for existing offences and acts or omissions; it does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision establishes procedures and powers for obtaining warrants, searching, and seizing evidence. It refers to offences and contraventions under the Act but does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision provides indemnity for Commission personnel for official-duty liabilities and certain litigation expenses. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision appoints the National Commissioner as Secretary to the Council and sets out administrative duties. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision establishes personal data processing principles, duties, and compatibility criteria, but does not itself create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

Subsection (2) expressly makes specified contraventions by Council members offences and provides fines and imprisonment on conviction. The inconsistent paragraph references do not alter its creation of punishable conduct and penalties.
The provision establishes constitutional safeguards for conviction, punishment, the presumption of innocence, and forfeiture. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision governs cessation and removal of Council members and filling vacancies. It mentions conviction and serious misconduct as grounds for loss of membership but does not create or list punishable offences or prescribe their penalties.
The provision governs appointment procedures and qualifications for Council members. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision sets transitional rules governing when inheritance-law provisions apply. Its mention of a criminal act only determines temporal applicability; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision regulates the National Ombudsman's investigative duties, appointment, suspension or dismissal, powers, and working methods. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Section 49 makes failure by a data controller or data processor to comply with orders under section 47 an offence and prescribes a fine, imprisonment for up to one year, or both.
This provision defines the Act’s scope of application to personal-data processing. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Bestemmelsen pålegger ektefelle eller gjenlevende samboer å utarbeide en fortegnelse over eiendeler og forpliktelser når retten ber om det. Den fastsetter ikke straffbar atferd eller noen straff eller administrativ sanksjon.

The provision governs the jurisdiction, composition and procedure of the Court of Impeachment, including a minimum limitation period. It refers to punishable or otherwise unlawful breaches of constitutional duties but does not itself create an offence or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes procedures and conditions for compulsory composition of an estate’s debts, including court approval and payment of priority claims. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Bestemmelsen regulerer bortfall av retten til uskifte ved ekteskap og arvingers adgang til å kreve skifte ved nytt samboerskap. Den fastsetter ikke straffbar atferd eller noen straff eller administrativ sanksjon.
The provision governs division of an undivided estate between heirs and the surviving spouse. It neither creates or lists punishable conduct nor establishes a penalty.

Provision establishes Datatilsynet’s status, independence, leadership and supervisory authority, and permits regulations on control costs. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Bestemmelsen pålegger bostyreren å føre protokoll og regnskap og holde boets midler atskilt fra andre midler. Den fastsetter ingen straffbar handling, overtredelse eller sanksjon.

The provision establishes exceptions to information, access, and data-breach notification rights and duties, and requires written reasons for refusing access. Its reference to criminal acts concerns confidentiality for prevention and investigation; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision governs civil liability and restitution of inheritance received in excess, including allocation of liability, valuation, and recovery from recipients acting in bad faith. It does not create an offence, administrative infraction, or punitive penalty.
The provision creates the offense of failure to control widely dangerous means, specifies the conduct and circumstances constituting it, and classifies it as a misdemeanor.
This provision sets a rule for determining an offense’s grade or class based on the established state of mind. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision defines conduct constituting credit card theft and credit card forgery in subsections (a)–(g), and classifies both offenses as class C felonies in subsections (h)–(i).

Subsection (a) creates the offense of intentionally or knowingly manufacturing, selling, furnishing, transporting, or importing deceptive identification documents, including offers to do so. Subsection (c) classifies the offense as a class C felony.

The provision creates the offence of misconduct in public office for a public official who commits illegal acts under color of office or willfully neglects legally prescribed duties, and classifies it as a class B felony.
The provision only defines terms used in the Code; it does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
The provision establishes public-records access duties, a response deadline, and responsibility for production costs. It does not create or list an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs transmission, consideration, and enactment of the Code and authorizes amendments. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision governs custody, handling, notice, and agency duties for property seized for forfeiture. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

El artículo tipifica conductas indebidas en situaciones de insolvencia o iliquidez y establece penas de hasta cinco años de privación de libertad o multa, y de hasta dos años o multa para los supuestos de negligencia.

The provision establishes constitutional rights and prohibitions concerning life, the death penalty, torture, slavery, and forced labour, and duties of state protection. It does not itself create or list offences or prescribe penalties.
La disposición regula los efectos del endoso y las facultades del portador de una letra de cambio endosada en blanco; no establece conductas punibles ni sanciones.
The provision establishes a conflict-of-law rule that supersedes conflicting laws; it does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.
The provision sets rules for displaying the Republic’s flag with other nations’ flags, but does not declare violations punishable or prescribe a penalty.
La disposición regula el alcance de la garantía prendaria y la preferencia de pago. La mención de intereses punitorios y cláusulas penales no crea conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.

El inciso 1º tipifica la producción o utilización de una graficación técnica no auténtica con intención de inducir a error sobre su autenticidad y establece prisión de hasta cinco años o multa. Los incisos 4º y 5º incluyen la manipulación del proceso de producción y la tentativa.

La disposición establece una regla procesal que permite examinar a los testigos en un lugar cuando ello contribuya a la eficacia del testimonio. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una sanción.
La disposición regula el plazo para cumplir sanciones impuestas por una resolución firme (cinco días hábiles). No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece una pena.

La disposición regula la búsqueda de la verdad material y la obtención de dictámenes e informes durante el procedimiento administrativo sancionador. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
El artículo establece el régimen aplicable a los partidos y movimientos políticos y garantiza el derecho de asociación política. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
La disposición regula cuándo resulta exigible una pena al deudor en mora; no crea una infracción ni establece una sanción por una conducta punible.

El artículo establece condiciones, obligaciones y mecanismos de control del beneficiario de un acuerdo de colaboración. No tipifica infracciones ni fija penas por su incumplimiento; la mención de un nuevo delito doloso es una condición del beneficio, no la creación de un delito.
The provision prohibits producing, selling, or donating unfit food, but does not designate that conduct as an offence or infraction or establish a penalty.
El artículo impone al factor obligaciones relativas al registro de la contabilidad y la rendición de cuentas, pero no tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.

La disposición regula la reserva de propiedad en la compraventa, la asunción del riesgo y la adquisición de la propiedad mediante el pago. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece penas o sanciones.

El artículo enumera atribuciones del Presidente de la República y no crea ni lista conductas punibles o sanciones. La facultad de conceder indultos y conmutar penas solo se refiere a penas ya existentes.
The provision requires written authorization to assign a deposit and makes an unauthorized assignment void. Nullity is a civil validity consequence, not a punishable offence or penalty.
La disposición regula la subrogación del fiador que paga la deuda y limita su derecho de cobro frente al deudor. No establece conductas punibles ni sanciones.

The provision itself imposes forfeiture of property used, intended for use, or facilitating an offense under this chapter, including attempts and conspiracies. The reference to Chapter 7 governs the requirements for that forfeiture.
The provision requires public authorities to assist persons with disabilities in securing subsistence, preparing for work, and social communication. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
La disposición regula las formalidades, los plazos y el control de admisibilidad de los recursos judiciales. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas o sanciones.
The provision states that a statute determines the organisation of the Constitutional Tribunal and the procedure before it. It does not create or list punishable conduct or any penalty.

La disposición establece derechos y restricciones de participación política para miembros de las Fuerzas Armadas y de la Policía Nacional, pero no tipifica una infracción ni establece una pena o sanción.
La disposición establece un mandato general al Estado para combatir y sancionar el tráfico ilícito de drogas, pero no tipifica una infracción ni establece una pena concreta.

La disposición establece reglas procesales para el concurso de delitos y la acumulación de procesos de acción privada. La referencia al delito con pena más grave solo determina el trámite aplicable; no crea conductas punibles ni establece penas.
Regulates extended special confiscation following an unlawful act defined elsewhere. It is a sentencing-related confiscation rule, not a provision creating or listing punishable conduct.
Przepis przyznaje jednostkom samorządu terytorialnego osobowość prawną, prawa majątkowe oraz sądową ochronę samodzielności. Nie określa czynu zabronionego ani kary.

The provision establishes immunity and procedural safeguards for members of the Tribunal of State concerning criminal liability, detention, and arrest. It does not create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs the authority and procedure for recognizing a foreigner as a Polish citizen, including obtaining security information. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

La disposición regula el procedimiento de identificación del imputado, incluso cuando se niega a proporcionar datos o los proporciona falsamente. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece penas o sanciones.

Article 190 governs the binding effect, publication, entry into force, and voting requirements of Constitutional Tribunal judgments, as well as their consequences for reopening proceedings. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision governs adoption, preparation, and execution of the state budget and provisional budgeting. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
La disposición regula el uso de la pared medianera y prohíbe abrir ventanas o claraboyas, pero no tipifica una infracción punible ni establece una pena o multa.
The provision grants the Council of Ministers exclusive legislative initiative for specified budgetary and public-finance laws. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision governs urgent legislative procedures, including eligible bills and deadlines for Senate consideration and presidential signature. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
Przepis ustanawia immunitet sędziowski oraz zasady zatrzymania i pociągnięcia sędziego do odpowiedzialności karnej. Nie określa czynu zabronionego ani kary.

El apartado 3 establece una multa para los sujetos procesales y demás participantes que infrinjan las prohibiciones de publicación previstas en los apartados 1 y 2. Por tanto, el propio artículo identifica la conducta sancionable y su sanción.

The provision specifies circumstances in which a Senator vacates office. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty; removal by court decision is merely a ground for vacating the seat.

This provision establishes due process rights, limits on punishment, statute-of-limitations rules, and extradition rules. It neither creates nor lists punishable conduct or penalties; its references to offences and penalties concern protections and rules governing their application.
The provision establishes eligibility requirements for entering public service. It refers to prior convictions and dismissals but does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This provision governs confirmation, removal, or extension following a probationary period. Removal for incompetence is an employment consequence, not a penalty for punishable conduct.
The provision sets terms of office for court leaders and refers to another law governing other judges’ terms. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision establishes the responsibilities and organisation of the National Public Prosecution Authority. It mentions investigating and prosecuting offences but does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision grants a former President an exemption from prosecution under specified conditions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision requires consent from a minor aged 16 or older for specified citizenship decisions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision governs salary entitlements during suspension and following acquittal, conviction, or disciplinary sanction. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty for a specified offence.
The provision regulates recording fines imposed on workers and how collected fines may be used. It does not itself establish punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs the Cabinet’s responsibilities, deliberations, and procedures. It neither creates or lists punishable conduct nor establishes a penalty.
The provision establishes a procedure for a dissatisfied public servant to refer an appeal decision to a court. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision prohibits general confiscation of property and requires a judicial judgment for specific confiscation as punishment. It regulates punishment rather than creating or listing punishable conduct or prescribing a penalty for an offence.

The provision replaces the previous Labour Law, repeals conflicting rules, and preserves existing regulations and decisions until amended. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes State duties concerning education and welfare for persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
الفقرة الثانية تجيز فرض غرامة على صاحب العمل عند حسم مبالغ من أجر العامل أو تأخير سداده دون مسوغ، وتحدد حدها الأقصى بضعف المبلغ المحسوم أو الأجر المتأخر.
تفرض المادة على صاحب العمل واجب إبلاغ مكتب العمل ببيانات المنشأة عند بدء العمل، لكنها لا تنص على أن مخالفة هذا الواجب جريمة أو مخالفة معاقبًا عليها، ولا تحدد عقوبة.

This provision guarantees liberty and security and requires a legal basis for prosecution, detention, punishment, and security measures. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes a general duty to bear public burdens and contributions, including taxes prescribed by statute. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision requires employers to provide seats for women workers to rest, but it does not define an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.

The provision governs the King’s appointment and dismissal of ministers, their collective responsibility before him, and his power to dissolve and reconstitute the Council of Ministers. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision directly imposes a fine of 200,000 to 500,000 Saudi riyals on anyone who violates paragraph (1) of Article 30. It therefore establishes punishable conduct and its penalty, notwithstanding its reference to Article 229.
The provision sets a twelve-month time limit for bringing labour claims, with exceptions, and requires expedited consideration of labour cases. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

L’article 60 prévoit des exceptions à l’application de l’article 58 pour certains traitements de données. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable ou de sanction ; les condamnations pénales et infractions sont seulement mentionnées comme finalités de ces traitements.
تنظم المادة حساب المدد والمواعيد وفق التقويم الهجري، ما لم يُنص على خلاف ذلك في عقد العمل أو لائحة تنظيم العمل، ولا تنشئ مخالفة أو عقوبة.

L’article 20 énumère les traitements de données soumis à une autorisation préalable de la Commission des Données Personnelles. Il ne qualifie aucun comportement d’infraction et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

The provision sets procedural safeguards for imposing disciplinary sanctions, including notice, questioning, investigation of the worker’s defence, and recordkeeping. Its references to warnings and fines describe when oral questioning is permitted; they do not create punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
L’article 41 énumère des exceptions à l’interdiction de traitement prévue à l’article précédent et encadre certains traitements. Il ne crée ni ne liste une infraction ou une sanction.
L’article 55 précise les informations à inclure dans une demande d’autorisation d’interconnexion. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
L’article 22 règle la saisine du Conseil constitutionnel, le sursis à statuer, le délai de décision et l’inapplicabilité d’une disposition inconstitutionnelle. Il ne crée ni infraction ni sanction.
Cette disposition renvoie au Code pénal et à la loi relative à la cybercriminalité pour définir et réprimer les infractions, sans créer ni énumérer elle-même de conduite punissable ou de peine.
Cette disposition fixe les règles de délibération du Conseil constitutionnel, d’intérim du président et de départage des voix. Elle ne crée aucune infraction et ne prévoit aucune peine.

L’article 68 établit des droits d’opposition et d’information relatifs au traitement des données personnelles, ainsi qu’une exception en cas d’obligation légale. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.

L’article 42 limite les personnes autorisées à traiter certaines données. Il ne qualifie pas le non-respect de cette restriction d’infraction et ne prévoit aucune peine ; les infractions mentionnées sont des catégories de données.
L’article 77 fixe des délais de mise en conformité des traitements de données avec la loi. Il ne crée ni ne liste de conduite punissable et ne prévoit aucune sanction.
The provision establishes rights of access to official information and permissible limitations on those rights. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
Subsection (7) imposes a fixed civil penalty of SCR 1,000 for registering a birth after the 30-day deadline, plus SCR 25 for each day of continued contravention.

The provision creates an offence of concealing, privately burying, or otherwise disposing of the body of a person killed or who died from a blow or wound, punishable by a fine of up to five hundred rupees or imprisonment for up to two years.
This provision imposes a duty to report offences against the Act to the police. It does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

L’article 21 fixe les conditions d’autorisation de certains traitements automatisés de données personnelles et en énumère les finalités. Il ne crée ni infraction ni sanction ; les infractions et condamnations pénales sont seulement mentionnées comme finalités de traitement.

The provision governs enforcement authority, ministerial schedules, court proceedings, appeals, and settlement of violations. It refers to penalties established in Article 229 but does not itself create or list punishable conduct or establish a penalty.
The provision governs the place and time of National Assembly meetings. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The article establishes procedures and remedies for Charter infringements, including declarations, orders, and compensatory damages. It does not create or list any offence, punishable infraction, or penalty.
The provision restricts when a civil status officer may act and permits another officer to act instead. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision establishes a constitutional right to privacy and exceptions to that right. It does not create or list any offence, punishable infraction, or penalty.
The provision recognises family rights and permits legally prescribed restrictions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision sets rules for registering a child's surname and applies procedures for surname-change petitions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The article establishes a constitutional procedure for investigating allegations and removing the President from office. It does not create or list an offence, administrative infraction, or punitive penalty.
This provision gives effect to transitional provisions in Schedule 7 despite conflicting constitutional provisions. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Article 71 imposes data-security obligations on the data controller but does not itself define an offence or infraction, list punishable conduct, or prescribe a penalty.
Subsection (2) makes exacting, imposing, causing, or permitting forced labour an offence and prescribes a minimum fine, imprisonment, or both, plus compensation to the victim.

Subsection (3) creates an offence for a craftsman who, without just cause, refuses to issue the certificate of release required by subsection (2), and prescribes a fine of not less than six months’ national minimum wage.

The provision defines when termination is unfair and lists reasons that cannot justify termination or disciplinary action. It does not create an offence or administrative infraction, or prescribe a penalty.
The provision permits employers to offer better terms and conditions of service. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision establishes the Commissioner’s inspection, enforcement, delegation and immunity powers. It does not create or list an offence or prescribe a penalty; its reference to proceedings for contraventions concerns enforcement of duties established elsewhere.

The provision sets annual reporting duties and required report contents. Its reference to statistics on violations, offences, and penalties imposed does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision regulates the transfer, custody, record management, and access to electoral documents. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.

This provision sets evidentiary rules for termination claims, including the employer’s burden of proof and a presumption of unfair termination. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision sets conditions for permissible shift-working hours, including written worker agreement, but does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
Subsection (1) establishes fines of 33 euros and 100 euros for the infractions specified in § 40.

The provision sets conditions for employer loans or wage advances, including no interest and a written, understandable, signed agreement for enforceability. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or penalty.
The provision establishes tax incentives for employing persons with disabilities or for their businesses. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes rules for ballot validity and counting preferential votes. Invalidating ballots or disregarding preferential votes is not a punishable offence or a penalty.
The provision makes a contractual term for wages below the fixed minimum null and void. It does not create an offence or infraction or impose a penalty.

The provision regulates the reasonableness, consistency, review, and revocation of workplace disciplinary penalties. It does not itself create or list an offence or other punishable conduct, or prescribe a penalty for such conduct.

The provision establishes eligibility requirements for election as a municipal mayor (residence in the municipality and age of at least 25 on election day). It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision contains transitional rules on election commissions, the application of prior election laws, and formation of the first state commission. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe any penalty.
The provision governs the counting of votes by a precinct electoral commission, excluding invalid ballots and recording results. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
This provision specifies the information that must be included when declaring referendum results, including separate vote totals for each proposal. It creates no offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision is a transitional rule treating an existing state commission member as delegated by the President of the Supreme Administrative Court from 1 August 2021. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision regulates the preparation, verification, printing, and contents of ballot papers for elections of a regional chairperson. It does not create or list any punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision establishes barriers to eligibility for election, including imprisonment, an unexpunged conviction for an intentional crime, and deprivation of legal capacity. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

This provision governs companies’ legal status, capacity, civil liability, notice, and continuity following amendments or name changes. It does not create or list punishable conduct or impose a penalty.
The provision establishes duties to inform voters about elections, including voters in detention or prison. It neither defines punishable conduct nor prescribes a penalty.

The provision sets procedural and organizational rules for simultaneous municipal and regional elections, including voting hours, counting order, voter lists, and ballot materials. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision expressly creates an offence by declaring that any person who contravenes section 54 is guilty of an offence.

The provision establishes procedures and powers for investigating complaints, including appointing investigators and allocating investigation costs. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Section 31(4) expressly creates offences for a company that fails to accommodate or unreasonably refuses a lawful request for access to records, or impedes, interferes with, or attempts to frustrate the exercise of rights under this section.

This provision governs procedural outcomes of an investigation, including referrals, court proceedings, reports, and compliance notices. It mentions referring alleged offences to prosecuting or regulatory authorities but does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes that the English text prevails when different texts of the Constitution conflict. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.

The provision regulates share issuance and specifies civil consequences of unauthorised issues, including nullity, repayment with interest, and director liability by reference to section 77. It does not itself create or list an offence, administrative infraction, or punitive penalty.
The provision sets out procedures for determining jurisdiction over a complaint and referring it to another regulatory body. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
This section establishes shareholders’ pre-emptive subscription rights and rules governing share offers. It does not create or list any offence, infraction, or penalty.

The provision sets out the practitioner's investigative, reporting, and remedial duties during business rescue. Its reference to fraud, reckless trading, and possible prosecution does not itself create or list offences or prescribe penalties.
El artículo establece el objeto y el ámbito de aplicación del reglamento y define los cargos comprendidos. Solo menciona el régimen sancionador; no tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
This provision establishes investigative powers to enter, search, question, copy records and seize items. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes procedures for challenging and suspending administrative acts or agreements that violate coastal law. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

El artículo regula la composición, funcionamiento y facultades del Comité Consultivo. Solo menciona el régimen de infracciones y sanciones al establecer una función consultiva; no crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece penas.
The provision requires the designation of deputy information officers and delegation of powers or duties. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision establishes investment requirements, limits, and compliance periods for venture capital entities. It does not classify any conduct as an offence or infraction or prescribe a penalty.
La disposición regula quién ejerce como Secretario del Consejo y sus funciones. No crea ni enumera conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
La disposición regula el funcionamiento de las Juntas Locales de Seguridad y la normativa aplicable a sus reglamentos; no tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
La disposición atribuye potestad tributaria sobre las retribuciones de consejeros; no tipifica conductas sancionables ni establece penas o multas.

La disposición regula el requerimiento y la aportación de títulos de propiedad en el procedimiento de embargo y subasta, así como su sustitución cuando no existan o no se presenten. No tipifica conductas punibles ni establece sanciones.
El artículo regula la recuperación administrativa de la posesión de bienes demaniales cuando deja de estar legitimada su ocupación. No tipifica una infracción ni establece una pena o sanción.

El artículo regula el desarrollo de las apuestas, las obligaciones del operador y la asignación de premios, sin tipificar infracciones ni establecer penas o multas. La mención al ejercicio de la potestad sancionadora no crea por sí misma conductas punibles ni sanciones.

El artículo no crea ni enumera conductas sancionables ni establece penas. Remite al régimen de infracciones y sanciones tributarias y aclara que las resoluciones sancionadoras del Consorcio no impiden el ejercicio de las competencias de comprobación de las Administraciones tributarias.

Establece requisitos sanitarios y de certificación para la importación de aves, así como análisis a cargo de los interesados si falta la certificación. No tipifica una infracción ni establece una pena o sanción; los gastos de los análisis no son una multa.
This provision prescribes procedural formalities for attachment by a bailiff. The consequence of noncompliance is nullity of the attachment document, not an offence, fine, or other punishment.

This provision governs civil enforcement against a third-party garnishee, including payment obligations, damages, procedural deadlines, and costs. It does not create an offence or administrative infraction or prescribe a punitive penalty.

This provision establishes a procedure to challenge an improperly conducted seizure and execution sale. The consequence of failing to register the claim within three days is inadmissibility, a procedural consequence rather than a punishment for an offence or infraction.

This provision governs civil procedure for disputes over court-ordered security and related deadlines. The loss of procedural powers for failing to meet a deadline is not an offence, infraction, fine, or other punishment.

This provision regulates conservatory attachment of aircraft, judicial competence, and cancellation of registration. The obligation to cancel registration 'op straffe van schadevergoeding' concerns civil compensation, not an offence, fine, or administrative infraction.

De bepaling regelt het onverwijld storten van een executieoverschot bij een bewaarder ten behoeve van de betreffende echtgenoot. Zij stelt geen strafbaar feit of administratieve overtreding vast en bepaalt geen sanctie.

This provision sets procedural rules for rescheduling an execution sale and notifying claims, including deadlines, conditions, and formalities. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

Deze bepaling regelt uitsluitend de procedure voor hoger beroep tegen een beschikking van de kantonrechter, waaronder de beroepstermijn en het horen of oproepen van partijen. Zij creëert geen strafbare gedraging of sanctie.

This procedural provision requires the clerk to provide a copy of the judgment upon request. Its reference to damages concerns civil compensation for noncompliance, not an offence, fine, or administrative infraction.

Artikel 38 regelt de indiening van kandidatenlijsten, de openbare kennisgeving en de vorm en beschikbaarheid van formulieren. Het creëert geen strafbaar feit of andere beboetbare gedraging en bepaalt geen sanctie.

The provision creates the offences of unlawful import or export committed through gross negligence, specifies punishable failures and false statements, and prescribes fines or imprisonment for up to two years. Minor acts are exempt from liability.

Bestämmelsen straffbelägger uppsåtlig eller oaktsam användning av radiosändare utan erforderligt tillstånd eller i strid med tillståndsvillkor, samt överträdelser av angivna föreskrifter. Straffet är böter eller fängelse i högst sex månader.

The provision governs the court’s choice of sentence, including factors favoring a sanction less severe than imprisonment and prior offending as a reason for imprisonment. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty for an offence.

De bepaling regelt de overeenkomstige toepassing van beslagprocedures en vereist dat de beslagen vordering uitdrukkelijk in het verzoekschrift wordt omschreven. Zij creëert geen strafbaar feit of sanctie.
The provision makes intentional or negligent violations of regulations issued by the Swedish Radiation Safety Authority under the specified sections punishable by a fine.

The provision creates punishable offences: intentional or negligent violations of Chapter 5, Sections 2 or 3 are punishable by monetary fines, and intentional or negligent violations of Chapter 6, Section 12 by masters or shipowners are punishable by fines.

The provision creates the offence of honour-based oppression (hedersförtryck): specified criminal acts committed or participated in to preserve or restore honour, forming repeated violations of a person's integrity and likely to seriously damage their self-esteem. It prescribes imprisonment for one to six years.
The provision requires a copy of the writ to be left with each person served. It is a procedural rule and creates no offence or penalty.

The provision exempts a person from liability when they exceed otherwise permitted conduct in circumstances where they could hardly control themselves. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
The provision governs changes to the conditions of an enforcement sale and the deadline for requesting them. It does not create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Provisionen begränsar tillämpningen av avtalets beskattningsregler till fall där de inskränker skattskyldigheten i Sverige. Den föreskriver inte någon straffbar handling eller påföljd.

Bestämmelsen föreskriver hur hälsovarningar ska återges vid marknadsföring och anger ett undantag för fysiska försäljningsställen. Den anger inte att överträdelser är straffbara och föreskriver ingen påföljd.
The provision specifies where customs clearance takes place under the relevant country's customs rules. It creates no punishable conduct and prescribes no penalty.
The provision defines eligibility to vote in cantonal matters and provides a procedure for demonstrating capacity and regaining voting rights. It creates no punishable conduct or penalty.
The provision governs recovery of grants and permits waiving repayment for special reasons. It does not create or list an offence, infraction, or punitive penalty.

The provision governs extradition for the existing offence of enforced disappearance, including its non-political classification, treaty coverage, and conditions for extradition. It does not create punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.

The provision makes intentional noncompliance with an official order issued during a review under Article 22 punishable by a fine of up to CHF 10,000, provided the order refers to this article’s penalty.
Die Bestimmung regelt die Höhe und Voraussetzungen von Darlehen für Mietwohnungen. Sie schafft weder strafbares Verhalten noch eine Strafe oder andere Sanktion.

This provision sets limitation periods for initiating and conducting criminal investigations and related obligations. It refers to offences defined elsewhere but does not itself create or list punishable conduct or prescribe a penalty.
Die Vorschrift regelt nur die Zusammensetzung und Höhe fester Finanzierungsbeiträge. Sie schafft weder einen Straftatbestand noch eine sonstige sanktionierbare Handlung oder eine Strafe.

Paragraph 1 criminalizes committing an act classified as a felony or misdemeanour while incapable of responsibility due to self-induced intoxication or stupefaction and prescribes a monetary penalty.
